dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a near-linear spline with minimal concavity as it descends from the apex to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a sharp morphological point and minimal pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep angular steepness, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-dominant ratio, with vertical pixel height approximately 1.8 times the base pixel width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex curvature of the melon with a consistent radius leading to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a pixel length roughly equal to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Defined obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the horizontal rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Translucent or luminescent pixel shading throughout the body; caudal flukes exhibit exceptionally acute and elongated distal tips.
